classification.difficultyReason: Find several related angles in divided, inscribed and overlapping right triangles, using perpendicularity, triangle angle sums and rectangle properties.

content.prompt: Determine the value of the pronumerals in these diagrams.

spec.description: Upright triangle divided by a perpendicular from the apex to its base. The left subtriangle is highlighted green.
spec.mathematics: Left base angle 60 degrees, right base angle 50 degrees; apex sectors a and c; right sector at the divider foot b; left foot sector marked right.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown labels only; supplied answers are excluded.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$; each triangle has angle sum $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}b+90&=180\\b&=90^\circ\\a+60+90&=180\\a+150&=180\\a&=30^\circ\\c+50+90&=180\\c+140&=180\\c&=40^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Upright divided triangle with the right subtriangle highlighted green.
spec.mathematics: Left apex angle 20 degrees; right apex f; left base e; right base 58 degrees; left foot d and right foot marked right.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown labels only; supplied answers are excluded.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$; each triangle has angle sum $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}d+90&=180\\d&=90^\circ\\e+20+90&=180\\e+110&=180\\e&=70^\circ\\f+58+90&=180\\f+148&=180\\f&=32^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Green outer triangle with a black perpendicular divider.
spec.mathematics: Apex sectors 39 and 22 degrees, left base g and right base h; left foot marked right.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown labels only; supplied answers are excluded.

answer.worked:
The divider is perpendicular to the base, so both angles at its foot are $90^\circ$. Use the angle sum of each triangle.
$$\begin{align*}g+39+90&=180\\g+129&=180\\g&=51^\circ\\h+22+90&=180\\h+112&=180\\h&=68^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Right triangle divided by an apex-to-base perpendicular; the left subtriangle is highlighted green.
spec.mathematics: The complete apex angle is right, split into b and a. Left base c, right base 32 degrees. The divider foot is also marked right.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown labels only; supplied answers are excluded.

answer.worked:
Use the right subtriangle's angle sum, the complete right angle at the apex, then the left subtriangle's angle sum.
$$\begin{align*}a+32+90&=180\\a+122&=180\\a&=58^\circ\\b+58&=90\\b&=32^\circ\\c+32+90&=180\\c+122&=180\\c&=58^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Inverted green right triangle with a black perpendicular divider from the top side to the bottom vertex.
spec.mathematics: Top-left angle f, top-right d. Bottom sectors e and 47 degrees together form a right angle. The right angle at the divider's top foot is marked.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown labels only; supplied answers are excluded.

answer.worked:
Use each triangle's angle sum and the complete right angle at the bottom vertex.
$$\begin{align*}d+47+90&=180\\d+137&=180\\d&=43^\circ\\e+47&=90\\e&=43^\circ\\f+43+90&=180\\f+133&=180\\f&=47^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Right triangle with highlighted horizontal and vertical legs, and a perpendicular from its right-angle vertex to its hypotenuse.
spec.mathematics: Bottom-left given 55 degrees, top-right h, and g between the internal perpendicular and the right vertical side. Both right-angle markers are retained.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown labels only; supplied answers are excluded.

answer.worked:
Use the angle sums of the outer triangle and the upper right triangle.
$$\begin{align*}h+55+90&=180\\h+145&=180\\h&=35^\circ\\g+35+90&=180\\g+125&=180\\g&=55^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Wide rectangle containing a highlighted right triangle with vertices at both bottom corners and a point on the top side.
spec.mathematics: All rectangle corners are right. The two green segments meet perpendicularly. Top sectors e and a; bottom-left sectors d and c; bottom-right sectors b and 56 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown labels only; supplied answers are excluded.

answer.worked:
Rectangle corners are right angles. Use the angle sum of the inscribed right triangle. The top and bottom sides are parallel, so alternate angles are equal.
$$\begin{align*}b+56&=90\\b&=34^\circ\\c+34+90&=180\\c+124&=180\\c&=56^\circ\\d+56&=90\\d&=34^\circ\\a&=b=34^\circ\\e&=c=56^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Tall rectangle with two black segments from its left corners meeting perpendicularly on the right side. The top, right and bottom sides are green.
spec.mathematics: Top-left sectors j and i; bottom-left h and g; right meeting point has 44 degrees above and f below. Top-right, bottom-right and internal meeting angle are marked right.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown labels only; supplied answers are excluded.

answer.worked:
At the point on the right side, the three adjacent angles form a straight angle. Use triangle angle sums and the rectangle's right-angle corners.
$$\begin{align*}f+90+44&=180\\f+134&=180\\f&=46^\circ\\g+46+90&=180\\g+136&=180\\g&=44^\circ\\h+44&=90\\h&=46^\circ\\j+44+90&=180\\j+134&=180\\j&=46^\circ\\i+46&=90\\i&=44^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Wide rectangle containing an inscribed green right triangle.
spec.mathematics: Top sectors n and m; bottom-left sectors o and 51 degrees; bottom-right k and l. All rectangle corners and the triangle's top angle are marked right.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown labels only; supplied answers are excluded.

answer.worked:
Use the inscribed triangle's angle sum and the rectangle's right-angle corners. The top and bottom sides are parallel, so alternate angles are equal.
$$\begin{align*}k+51+90&=180\\k+141&=180\\k&=39^\circ\\l+39&=90\\l&=51^\circ\\o+51&=90\\o&=39^\circ\\m&=k=39^\circ\\n&=51^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Overlapping black and green right triangles share a horizontal base. The black top-left vertex is higher than the green top-right vertex.
spec.mathematics: Both complete base-corner angles are right. Diagonals cross perpendicularly; c and f label opposite side sectors. Left base sectors a and b; top-left d; right base sectors 39 degrees and e; top-right g.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown labels only; supplied answers are excluded.

answer.short: $a=51^\circ,\ b=39^\circ,\ c=90^\circ,\ d=51^\circ,\ e=51^\circ,\ f=90^\circ,\ g=39^\circ$
answer.worked:
The diagonals are perpendicular, so $c=f=90^\circ$. Use the triangle angle sums and the complete right angles at the base.
$$\begin{align*}a+39+90&=180\\a+129&=180\\a&=51^\circ\\b+51&=90\\b&=39^\circ\\c&=90^\circ\\d+39+90&=180\\d+129&=180\\d&=51^\circ\\e+39&=90\\e&=51^\circ\\f&=90^\circ\\g+51+90&=180\\g+141&=180\\g&=39^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: A green right triangle overlaps a narrower, taller black right triangle on an extended horizontal base. Two separate crossings are retained.
spec.mathematics: Green top-left given 63 degrees, far-right o. Left base sectors i and j. Black top k. Perpendicular diagonal crossing has h and l. Green diagonal crossing black vertical has m above-left and p below-right. Black vertical foot has n on its right.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown labels only; supplied answers are excluded.

answer.short: $h=90^\circ,\ i=27^\circ,\ j=63^\circ,\ k=27^\circ,\ l=90^\circ,\ m=63^\circ,\ n=90^\circ,\ o=27^\circ,\ p=63^\circ$
answer.worked:
The diagonals are perpendicular, so $h=l=90^\circ$. Use triangle angle sums, right angles, straight angles and vertically opposite angles.
$$\begin{align*}h&=90^\circ\\i+63+90&=180\\i+153&=180\\i&=27^\circ\\j+27&=90\\j&=63^\circ\\k+63+90&=180\\k+153&=180\\k&=27^\circ\\l&=90^\circ\\m+27+90&=180\\m+117&=180\\m&=63^\circ\\n+90&=180\\n&=90^\circ\\o+63+90&=180\\o+153&=180\\o&=27^\circ\\p&=m=63^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Offset stacked black and green right triangles meet at a common right-hand vertex.
spec.mathematics: Upper top-left s, upper common-vertex r; lower bottom-left 52 degrees and lower common-vertex q. Both triangles have marked right angles. At the common vertex the horizontal and vertical rays are perpendicular, and the two hypotenuse rays are perpendicular.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown labels only; supplied answers are excluded.

answer.worked:
Use the lower triangle's angle sum. At the shared vertex, the perpendicular hypotenuses and the horizontal–vertical right angle give $r+(90-q)=90$. Then use the upper triangle's angle sum.
$$\begin{align*}q+52+90&=180\\q+142&=180\\q&=38^\circ\\r+(90-38)&=90\\r+52&=90\\r&=38^\circ\\s+38+90&=180\\s+128&=180\\s&=52^\circ\end{align*}$$
